extension.description: Subtitles from the SubtitleDB open index. No account and no key. Films are found by their IMDb id, episodes by series, season and episode number, and a subtitle recorded against the file you are playing is preferred over one that merely matches the title. With Load subtitles when a video starts turned on in the settings, a video that starts without subtitles in your language gets the best match at once.
extension.news: loading subtitles when a video starts is off until turned on in the settings; a film known only by its title and year is not loaded when the match is from another year; a subtitle with no lines is never loaded on play
